subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should the exact current head be authorized to move the Matrix workspace dependency and test API boundary from qa-matrix into qa-lab?
rationale: Repository automation deliberately blocks dependency graph changes until an administrator or security owner confirms the ownership move; model review cannot grant that authorization.

options.title: Authorize the ownership move
options.body: Approve the exact head after confirming qa-lab is the intended long-term owner of the Matrix QA dependency and test boundary.

options.title: Retain qa-matrix ownership
options.body: Remove the qa-lab dependency graph change and keep the compatibility package responsible until its final removal.

options.title: Pause for atomic migration
options.body: Defer this layer and combine the dependency transition with the final qa-matrix removal if temporary split ownership is too risky.

recommendation.title: Authorize the ownership move
recommendation.body: Approve the exact head after confirming qa-lab is the intended long-term owner of the Matrix QA dependency and test boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the migration stack and is the best available routing candidate for explaining the intended package boundary, though formal authorization still requires an administrator or security owner.
